_doc: Tiers change how much TASTE iteration runs, never the deterministic floor: every tier must pass the machine axes. `model_hint`/`effort_hint` are suggestions; the customer picks the model. vision_rounds = structured review rounds an agent must log (quality/review/round-N.json).

fast.label: PREVIEW
fast.note: machine gates only: a playable preview, NOT reviewed for taste

standard.label: SHIP
standard.note: one structured review round, fix the 3 worst, every vision axis >= 7

studio.label: SHIP
studio.note: 3+ rounds, every axis >= 8, each round must show its previous problems fixed
